content: {"like":["Values powerful, Oscar-worthy lead performances and compelling ensemble casts.","Prefers authentic, nuanced portrayals of rural life, historical settings, and complex human drama.","Enjoys tightly written scripts with strong plots, realistic themes, and minimal reliance on gimmicks.","Appreciates documentaries that are direct, unfiltered, and provide broad, insightful perspectives.","Seeks high-quality storytelling across platforms, especially on Amazon Prime, and enjoys well-crafted period pieces."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly written scripts, awkward dialogue, and miscasting that undermine authenticity.","Rejects excessive musical scoring, unsophisticated action, and distracting hair choices.","Criticizes trailers that are unengaging, misleading, or filled with cheap jokes and negative stereotypes.","Opposes identity politics-driven remakes, negative portrayals of LGBTQ+ themes, and lack of thoughtful messaging.","Finds interviewers and shows with low production quality, uninformed hosts, or sensationalist content unacceptable."]}
